overview:
Kevin Mullin, the Democratic incumbent, advanced to the general election in a Bay Area district that leans Democratic by 26 points. His Republican challenger, Charles Hoelter, has reported no fundraising, while Mullin has raised over $800,000 and holds cash on hand. No outside groups are spending meaningfully against him.

Prediction markets put Mullin's chances near 97%, and no expert raters list the race as competitive. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's partisan lean, incumbency, and the large financial edge, all pointing to a safe Democratic hold.
